article_title: Deaf patient given wrong jab due to sign language error, report says

tasks.prompt: What failure is the article mainly about?
options: A deaf patient received the wrong vaccine after a GP surgery failed to provide accessible BSL communication
A patient refused every vaccine offered at a hospital
A surgery closed because it had too many interpreters
A pharmacist lost a shipment of flu vaccines
tasks.correct_answer: A deaf patient received the wrong vaccine after a GP surgery failed to provide accessible BSL communication
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בכשל תקשורתי נגיש: מטופלת חירשת קיבלה חיסון שגוי לאחר שלא סופק לה תרגום מתאים לשפת הסימנים הבריטית.

tasks.prompt: Which vaccine had the patient booked, and which did she receive instead?
options: She booked a Covid vaccine and received a flu vaccine
She booked a flu vaccine and received a Covid vaccine
She booked a travel vaccine and received no injection
She booked a tetanus vaccine and received two flu vaccines
tasks.correct_answer: She booked a flu vaccine and received a Covid vaccine
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המטופלת הזמינה חיסון נגד שפעת אך קיבלה בטעות חיסון נגד קורונה.

tasks.prompt: What could have highlighted the vaccination error before the injection?
options: A telephone message without captions
A handwritten note from another patient
A British Sign Language video explaining the vaccine
A television news report
tasks.correct_answer: A British Sign Language video explaining the vaccine
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סרטון בשפת הסימנים הבריטית היה מאפשר למטופלת להבין איזה חיסון עומד להינתן ולהצביע על הטעות.

tasks.prompt: What does “inaccessible communication” mean in this case?
options: Communication sent too early
Information that was too expensive to print
A message written in a foreign alphabet
Information not provided in a form the deaf patient could understand
tasks.correct_answer: Information not provided in a form the deaf patient could understand
tasks.explanation_hebrew: תקשורת לא נגישה היא מידע שלא הוצג בפורמט שהמטופלת החירשת יכלה להבין, כגון BSL.

tasks.prompt: Which body investigated the complaint described in the article?
options: A private travel company
The Parliamentary and Health Service Ombudsman
A mobile-payment provider
A local sports association
tasks.correct_answer: The Parliamentary and Health Service Ombudsman
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נציב תלונות הציבור לענייני הפרלמנט ושירותי הבריאות חקר את המקרה ואת כשלי הנגישות.

options: Optional decorations in a waiting room
Changes made only after a court trial
Practical changes that remove disability-related barriers, such as arranging an interpreter
Discounts offered to every patient
tasks.correct_answer: Practical changes that remove disability-related barriers, such as arranging an interpreter
tasks.explanation_hebrew: reasonable adjustments הם שינויים מעשיים וסבירים שנועדו להסיר חסם הנובע ממוגבלות, למשל הזמנת מתורגמן.

tasks.prompt: Give three actions the GP surgery should have taken to support informed consent.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה צעדים מעשיים המבטיחים הבנה והסכמה מדעת.
expected_points: Arrange a qualified BSL interpreter
Provide the vaccine information in an accessible BSL format
Confirm which vaccine the patient had requested
Check the patient's understanding before administering the injection
Obtain clear informed consent for the specific vaccine
Record communication needs so staff can prepare for future appointments

tasks.prompt: Summarise what happened, why communication was central to the error and what the investigation concluded.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את החיסון שהוזמן, החיסון שניתן, היעדר הנגישות ומסקנת הדוח.
expected_points: The deaf patient booked a flu vaccination
She was given a Covid vaccination instead
No BSL interpreter was provided at the surgery
Staff did not show the accessible BSL material that could have exposed the mistake
The ombudsman found that inaccessible communication let the patient down
Healthcare providers have duties to make communication accessible and support consent

tasks.prompt: Why is providing an interpreter a patient-safety measure, not merely a courtesy?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין תקשורת נגישה לבין מידע רפואי נכון, הסכמה ומניעת טעויות.
expected_points: The patient must understand the proposed treatment
Accurate two-way communication allows the patient to correct errors
Informed consent is impossible without understandable information
Miscommunication can lead directly to the wrong medicine or vaccine
An interpreter enables questions about risks and alternatives
Accessibility supports equal and safe care

tasks.prompt: Using the article, propose a short accessibility checklist for a GP surgery before treating a deaf patient.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע צעדים מסודרים לפני הטיפול, במהלכו ואחריו, המבוססים על לקחי המקרה.
expected_points: Record the patient's preferred communication method when booking
Arrange a qualified BSL interpreter in advance
Provide accessible written or signed information
Verify the patient's identity and the exact treatment requested
Confirm understanding and specific consent before treatment
Do not rely on family members when professional interpretation is needed
Offer an accessible complaint and follow-up process
Review incidents and train staff to prevent repetition
